summary: Implemented Lambda and Lambdad transforms with aliases, docs, and tests; nothing was run and changes are uncommitted. Changes: monai/transforms/utility/array.py (Lambda appended; asserts callable(func) with "func must be callable"; __call__ returns func(img)); monai/transforms/utility/dictionary.py (typing import now "Callable, Optional"; Lambda added to the array import; Lambdad(MapTransform) between ConcatItemsd and the alias block, calling super().__init__ first, delegating to one internal Lambda over each listed key on a dict() copy; LambdaD = LambdaDict = Lambdad appended to the alias block); docs/source/transforms.rst (Lambda before SplitChannel, Lambdad after ConcatItemsd); new tests/test_lambda.py and tests/test_lambdad.py covering identity, slicing, keys view, unlisted-entry preservation, original-dict immutability, iterable-callable-applied-whole, and non-callable AssertionError. Not verified: flake8, black, and the test suite, since running code was ruled out.
